target_stage: Original merits judgment in E. No. 2/2011 on the Section 14(1)(b) eviction application, decided 26.10.2013
target_court: Rent Controller, New Delhi District, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi

IK-84524189:L91:span1.text: It is averred that none of the partners of the respondent who constituted the partnership firm M/s Gill & Co at the time of inception of tenancy are now the partner of the respondent no. 1 and none of the said partners is in actual possession or legal possession of the tenanted premises.

IK-84524189:L92:span2.text: tenanted premises to Sh. Ramesh Tewari and Sh Rajan Tewari, who constituted M/s Gill & Co and are in occupation of the entire shop.

IK-84524189:L94:span3.text: It is stated that change in constitution of partnership firm does not amount to change in tenancy and even otherwise the respondent firm still consists of partners who had taken the premises in question on rent.

IK-84524189:L97:span4.text: Rajan Tiwari was one of the partners at the commencement of tenancy on 19.8.1991; that the premises were let out to the partnership firm M/s Gill & Co and not to any individual partners in his individual capacity as tenant and the possession of the tenanted premises is still with the firm, i.e. M/s Gill & Co.

IK-84524189:L104:span5.text: at present, none of the partners, who were the partners of M/s Gill & Co at he time of inception of tenancy, are now the partners of the entity and the earlier partners have illegally sublet, assigned and parted with possession of the tenanted premises to some new partners

IK-84524189:L108:span6.text: the partnership firm M/s Gill & Co which consisted of four partners as mentioned in the partnership deed dated 17.8.1991 Ex. RW1A. The witness proved the Forms A and B issued by the office of Registrar of Firms as Ex. RW1/F and RW1/G.

IK-84524189:L109:span7.text: The witness has proved the account opening form, undertaking and letter of partnership all dated 5.12.1991 as Ex. RW1/B1 to B3
